is_cancelled is derived from dep_time IS NULL; the profile shows 4883 nulls (null_rate 0.029388) in dep_time, and operator context states a flight that never departed has no departure time, making this a useful consumer-facing flag.

dep_time, arr_time, dep_delay_minutes, arr_delay_minutes, and air_time_minutes all carry nonzero null rates (2.9%-3.3%) that co-occur with uncompleted flights; nulls are retained rather than imputed or dropped, per the operator note that a flight that never departed has no departure time.

dep_time, sched_dep_time, arr_time, and sched_arr_time all show max values of 2359.0 or 2400.0, an HHMM/HMM encoding rather than a standard clock time, so they are kept as INTEGER rather than cast to TIME to avoid misrepresenting the 2400 midnight marker.

Operator context prefers a single calendar DATE column over year/month/day parts, but this proposal's column-level action schema cannot merge three distinct bronze source columns into one target; year, month, and day are retained as separate required INTEGER columns (all null_rate 0.0) with this limitation flagged for a follow-up transformation.

purpose: This table holds cleaned scheduled and actual flight-event records for every departure from the three NYC airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) in the January-June 2013 window of nycflights13, feeding downstream on-time-performance and delay analyses.
usage: Consumers should treat the declared grain (year, month, day, carrier_code, flight_number, sched_dep_time) as the unit of analysis, filter or branch on the is_cancelled flag before computing delay statistics since dep_time, arr_time, dep_delay_minutes, arr_delay_minutes, and air_time_minutes are null for flights that never departed or completed, and should not assume dep_time/arr_time are standard clock times since they retain the source's HHMM encoding including the 2400 midnight marker.
limitations: Pipeline metadata columns (_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, _airbyte_meta) were dropped entirely; year, month, and day remain three separate integer columns rather than a single DATE column because this cleanup's column-level actions cannot merge multiple bronze columns into one target; dep_time, arr_time, dep_delay_minutes, arr_delay_minutes, and air_time_minutes retain null rates between 0.9% and 3.3% that were not imputed; and tail_number (0.9% null) was excluded from the grain despite being a plausible natural key component.
